pages.text: Hit $(bold)either$() target and you advance — bank the token threshold, or clear the boss-rush share (see $(l:icraft:progression/tier_gates)How You Advance$(/l)). This entry lists the targets tier by tier.$(br2)Check your standing any time with $(bold)/icraft codex balance$().

pages.title: Tier 1 → Tier 2
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Tokens:$() bank $(t2){{tier 1 threshold}}$().$(li)$(bold)Boss Rush:$() clear $(t2){{tier 1 rushpct}}$() of the {{tier 1 rushsize}} Tier 1 bosses ({{tier 1 rushneed}} kills).$(br2)Earn however you like — build Create machines, cultivate Botania mana, loot structures, or hunt Overworld bosses. Every lane feeds the same pool.

pages.title: Tier 2 → Tier 3
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Tokens:$() bank $(t3){{tier 2 threshold}}$().$(li)$(bold)Boss Rush:$() clear $(t3){{tier 2 rushpct}}$() of the {{tier 2 rushsize}} Tier 2 bosses ({{tier 2 rushneed}} kills), most of them in the Twilight Forest and Blue Skies.$(br2)Thermal machines, Ars Nouveau reagents, dimension loot, or dimensional bosses all count toward it.

pages.title: Tier 3 → Tier 4
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Tokens:$() bank $(t4){{tier 3 threshold}}$().$(li)$(bold)Boss Rush:$() clear $(t4){{tier 3 rushpct}}$() of the {{tier 3 rushsize}} Tier 3 bosses — Nether, Undergarden, Deeper Dark, and the Abyss — finishing with $(bold)Lucifer$().$(br2)$(warn)The combat pinch:$() the boss-rush route to T4 ends at Lucifer, the combat capstone. A combat-averse player simply banks {{tier 3 threshold}} tokens instead and never has to fight him.

pages.title: Tier 4 — the finale
pages.text: Tier 4 has $(bold)no token gate$() — it is the top of the ladder.$(br2)Tier 4 opens the Ad Astra planets (by rocket) and the End; the $(t4)Ender Dragon$() is the finale, not a gate. Eyes of Ender lead you to the End — see $(l:icraft:progression/dimensions)Dimensional Progression$(/l).
